name: bread
description: BREAD — the umbrella map for the stack: batch (own repo) + the grain monorepo (grain · mill · proof · crumb), plus the project-wide plans board (PANTRY-hosted).
author: Tjakoen Stolk <tjakoen.s@gmail.com> (https://tjakoen.github.io)

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in pantry; do bun add -d @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done && bun update @tjakoen/batch @tjakoen/grain @tjakoen/mill @tjakoen/proof

//devDependencies: The pins of record for the members. Since the 2026-07-19 grain-monorepo cutover, grain · mill · proof · batch are PUBLISHED packages (public npm registry since 2026-07-30 — the @tjakoen scope resolves there by default, so this repo carries NO .npmrc and needs no token) pinned to versions, NOT github SHAs; only pantry stays a github git-dep (it is an app, not published). deps:refresh re-pins pantry by sha and 'bun update's the four published layers. This umbrella stays LOCKLESS (bun.lock gitignored), but no longer because it has to: the nested graph — bread -> pantry -> tjakoen.github.io -> layers — DOES resolve from scratch as of 2026-07-30 (verified cold: purged @tjakoen cache, empty HOME, all 7 packages installed, pantry check OK). The old bread-bun-nested-git blocker was misattributed to bun. The real causes were pantry pinning a portfolio sha that had been deleted from the remote, and the GitHub Packages token wall underneath it; both are fixed. bread still needs no lock: everything runs via bunx (cockpit -> bunx pantry, plans:check -> bunx proof), which resolve in isolation and don't use bread's own node_modules. Do NOT try to regenerate a lock here. (standards was folded into the portfolio 2026-07-09 and its repo deleted; pantry resolves /standards from the tjakoen.github.io git-dep.)
